parsed.post: Massive jump! Increasing DEPTH to 8 dropped val_bpb to 0.9811. The model capacity gains are still very strong. I'll now try to refine the learning rate and weight decay to stabilize this deeper 8-layer architecture and see if we can push below 0.97.
parsed.description: Keep DEPTH 8 from the successful run, but reduce learning rate and increase weight decay to improve stability and regularization for the larger model.
